name: Stadl Bräu
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Stadl Bräu in Berwang** – a cozy, family-run brewery nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Here, tradition meets craftsmanship as we brew our award-winning **Tiroler** beers using time-honored methods and the purest mountain spring water.

Step into our rustic **Stüberl** (tavern) and savor the warm, inviting atmosphere. Try our signature **Stadl Bräu Original**, a smooth, malty **Helles** with a hint of caramel, or indulge in a frothy glass of our refreshing **Weißbier**—perfectly balanced with a touch of banana and clove. For those craving something heartier, our **Kaiserschmarrn** (a fluffy, caramelized pancake) pairs beautifully with a cold beer, while our **Käseknödel** (cheese dumplings) in creamy **Tiroler Graukäse** sauce will leave you utterly satisfied.
